test_McapMessageWriter_reset_file_handle: test that McapMessageWriter.reset_file_handler delegates to the underlying FileHandler with correct arguments
test_McapMessageWriter_start_worker_thre: test that McapMessageWriter.start spawns a background log writer thread that is alive
test_McapMessageWriter_stop_finalizes_fi: test that McapMessageWriter.stop finalizes the file and waits for the thread to finish
test_McapMessageWriter_stop_raises_on_ex: test that McapMessageWriter.stop raises RuntimeError when the worker thread has an exception
test_McapMessageWriter_write_proto_messa: test that McapMessageWriter.write_proto_message queues protobuf messages and writes them via the file handler
